podcast.title: Initial Skepticism for Play
podcast.body: The label "uv2" received Moby's *Play* album with significant skepticism, seeing potential but unsure how to proceed with it. Their marketing representative sent copies to critics, but even they showed little interest. "uv2 recibe el disco con mucho expecticismo ve potencial no sea muy bien que hacer con él."

srcs.episode: MOBY · PLAY. Influencia absoluta de la música de gran consumo

podcast.title: Small Initial Pressing of Play
podcast.body: "uv2" eventually decided to produce a small initial pressing of *Play*, which Moby largely had to finance himself. "su uv2 se cida a hacer una pequeña tirada que prácticamente acaba pagando movi de su bolsillo."
